newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keiyo to shut 600,000 tonne/yr cracker on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Keiyo to shut 600,000 tonne/yr cracker on Tuesday.

text.p: Keiyo Ethylene Co Ltd will close its naphtha cracker for scheduled maintenance on Tuesday, Maruzen Petrochemical Co Ltd said on Monday.

The facility is Japan's largest, with an annual ethylene production capacity of 600,000 tonnes, and runs solely on imported feedstock. It will resume operations on November 14, a Maruzen spokesman said.
Keiyo Ethylene is owned 55 percent by Maruzen and in equal parts by Sumitomo Chemical Co Ltd and Mitsui Petrochemical Industries Ltd.
